title: The Sealing Hand Course
summary: A course for those past the primers that seals a limb or a wound with the hand and teaches the first lasting seals.

title: A Treatise on Staying Locks
summary: A treatise on locks of qi that stay set in a joint after the hand has left it and hold the foe's step.

title: The Rivet and Clamp Method
summary: A method of driving narrow rivets of qi through a guard and clamping a limb or a poisoned wound shut.

title: Notes on the Capped Palm
summary: Notes on capping the palm with sealed qi so each touch closes a channel and a pushed wave seals those it strikes.

title: The Wedge and Peg Course
summary: A course in driving wedges and pegs of qi between a foe's guard and body to pin the arms out of play.

title: A Book of the Sealed Wound
summary: A book on closing wounds in friends and keeping them open in foes with seams of sealed qi and stitches of the same.

title: Method of the Barred Stance
summary: A method of standing barred across the foe's line so that his rush finds a crossbar of qi and holds there.
